name: Cloudflare
short_desc: External: Sign in once; your Wizard publishes sites, backs up files and manages domains.
author: Humanity Labs
description: Sign in to Cloudflare once (or create a free account there). The app shows each account's websites, storage and domains; your Wizard does the work: publish a Files folder as a website, back up folders to R2, change DNS and price domains. Every change waits for your Approve tap; nothing is deleted or bought. Configure your own shell host/origin and owner login.

form_fields.label: External: Gateway owner secret
form_fields.hint: Optional: for a gateway that injects X-Wizard-Owner-Token instead of Tailscale identity.
